Markets.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
Markets.summary: Eight of India's top ten firms lost Rs 1.55 lakh crore in market valuation amid a broader market downturn. The BSE Sensex fell by 1,605.44 points, with HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance experiencing the largest declines.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Do charts indicate a bearish picture for coming week?
Markets.summary: SBI Securities analyst Sudeep Shah expects continued weakness in Indian equities due to negative FII positioning, rising volatility, and technical indicators. He identifies key Nifty support and resistance levels while highlighting the IT sector as relatively strong.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett's retirement advice for investors emphasizes low-cost index funds, paying off high-interest debt, and keeping cash reserves. His core principles also include staying within one's circle of competence and living frugally to manage risk and build wealth.

Markets.title: 10 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Eleven low-priced stocks with market capitalizations under Rs 1,000 crore and share prices below Rs 20 surged up to 181% over a three-month period. ACE Equity data shows that Kapil Raj Finance and Tuni Textile Mills led these gains among the evaluated companies.

Markets.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
Markets.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors withdrew Rs 48,056 crore from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and elevated crude oil prices. Despite this heavy outflow, selling pressure showed signs of moderation with two days of net buying.

Markets.title: Swiggy may rebound to Rs 190, but charts do not signal a trend reversal: LKP’s Vatsal Bhuva
Markets.summary: LKP Securities analyst Vatsal Bhuva warns of continued downside risks for the Nifty and Bank Nifty indexes despite potential short-term rebounds in Swiggy and HDFC Bank. He also recommends buying Oriental Hotels and Apollo Hospitals based on improving technical indicators and favorable chart setups.

Geo-Political.summary: Nearly 1,000 people were arrested in France following widespread mass protests and violent clashes. Similar demonstrations also occurred in several other European countries.

Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli Defense Forces are closing West Bank crossings and restricting Palestinian workers ahead of Tuesday's election. This action is part of an escalating crackdown on the region.

Geo-Political.title: Voters in Brazil to choose between Lula and Bolsonaro's son
Geo-Political.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro is mounting a strong challenge against 80-year-old Lula in Brazil's upcoming presidential election. Lula, whose former president father is imprisoned, is seeking a fourth term in office.

Geo-Political.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX restricted Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network because the company accused the country of violating terms of service through military use. The service has since been restored.

Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen in north-east Nigeria killed at least 10 villagers and looted local shops. Police are currently searching for more casualties as officials warn the death toll may increase.

Data & Insights.summary: France's economic activity has contracted and borrowing risks have increased, raising concerns about the country's public finances. These financial pressures, worsened by protests affecting business confidence and tourism, have sparked fears of a broader economic meltdown across the euro zone.

Data & Insights.summary: India has installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity as of July 31, 2026. Experts state that expanding battery storage and modernizing the power grid are necessary to achieve the country's 500 GW target by 2030.

Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce and industry ministry is working to identify economic sectors capable of withstanding artificial intelligence-led disruption. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's workforce and industries for technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing capabilities during the construction of the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line. This rail project will feature 16 tunnels to advance connectivity in the Himalayas.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, increased new orders, and lower inflation. However, hiring growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year according to an HSBC flash survey.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Raising taxes on the top one percent of earners alone cannot solve income inequality. How governments choose to spend public funds is equally critical to achieving social justice.

India.title: 'Illegal Parallel System': Maharashtra Takes Top Food Safety Body To Court
India.summary: Maharashtra has filed a court petition against India's food safety authority over a May 2023 order. The contested directive had stripped state officers of their authority to inspect centrally licensed food companies and centralized business oversight.

India.title: Man Steals Uncle's Gold To Buy Thar, Invites Him To Its Puja, Gets Arrested
India.summary: A man stole gold from his uncle to buy a Mahindra Thar SUV and even invited his uncle to the vehicle's blessing ceremony. Police arrested the nephew after investigating how he suddenly afforded the new car.

India.title: OUSSSC Recruitment 2026 Begins For 7,268 Posts: Check Application Details

India.title: Is AI Bubble Waiting To Burst? Nikhil Kamath Warns Of Tougher Months Ahead
India.summary: Investor Nikhil Kamath warns that the artificial intelligence industry faces potential trouble because annual investments of nearly $1 trillion far exceed enterprise revenues of $100 billion to $200 billion.
